aiRender.title: The Home virtual staging
aiRender.intro: Upload a photo of your room (empty or furnished). We keep the walls and camera angle, replace the old furniture with real The Home pieces, and show prices with buy links.
aiRender.uploadTitle: Upload a photo of your room
aiRender.uploadBody: Empty or already furnished. Your photo is the structural guide; furniture is restaged from The Home catalog.
aiRender.analyzing: Reading perspective and scale from the photo…
aiRender.autoBody: Width, depth and camera perspective are estimated automatically. Ceiling height uses a 2.6 m residential prior.
aiRender.maskBody: Paint over anything that must stay (an existing sofa, a window, art). The generator will not replace those pixels.
aiRender.fallbackNotice: AI rendering is temporarily unavailable. Showing the The Home catalog scene for your selected style and budget.
aiRender.generate: Place The Home products in the room
aiRender.generating: Overlaying The Home pieces on your photo…
aiRender.resultAlt: Room with The Home product overlay
aiRender.hotspotHint: Click a product in the image for details and purchase.
aiRender.errorNeedPhoto: Please upload a photo of your room first.
aiRender.designProductsTitle: Products in this design - The Home
aiRender.designProductsBody: {count} The Home pieces placed in this room, with price and buy link.
aiRender.addSetToCart: Add the full set to cart
aiRender.setAdded: The set was added to your cart ({count} pieces).
aiRender.nonePlaced: Keep-mask covered the free floor. Erase some of the mask or raise the budget.
aiRender.errorAnalyze: Could not analyze this photo. Try another image.
aiRender.errorGenerate: Render failed. Try a different photo or mask.
